resolution_rule: A logical address is resolved relative to the repository root (discovered from the reader's own location) and the bytes are verified against the recorded sha256 before any answer is produced. An address whose file is absent or whose hash does not match is a delivery defect, reported as ANCHOR_MISSING / ANCHOR_HASH_MISMATCH - never as an environment error, and never answered from a placeholder.
path_rule: No author-machine absolute path is stored here. Every asset is addressed by repository-relative path under a logical address.

anchors.notes: The single fixed local snapshot this layer parses. Shipped in the repository so a clean clone can answer; the file is byte-identical to the copy recorded by the earlier ontology-navigation card. The registration record of this capability: registered, read-only, OFF by default, whitelist empty. It is the record that proves the capability is not in the effective profile.
The shipped class-to-CL mapping read by explain_class_mapping. Read-only: the layer reports what this file says and never rewrites it.
